observations: Many blue metal drums stacked closely outdoors/in a yard.
Each drum has a bung opening on the top and side openings/ports; some have visible lids/closures.
No readable brand/model or drum capacity markings are clearly visible in the photos.
Some drums show wear/dirt; exact condition (leaks, dents, rust) can’t be confirmed from these images.

identity.kind: metal drums for liquid storage (blue steel drums)

claims.claim: Can be used for storage of any kind of Liquid
claims.evidence: Photos show generic blue metal drums but do not show prior contents, lining/coating type, cleanliness, or leak-proof condition.

risks.risk: Not food-grade/chemical-compatible (previous contents or internal lining unknown), so “any liquid” may be unsafe or cause contamination/corrosion.
risks.proof: Ask for: (1) photos of any label/stenciling on the drum (previous contents/grade), (2) a photo of the inside (open bung) showing lining/coating condition.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as general-purpose used drums with unknown prior contents (assume not guaranteed for sensitive liquids).

risks.risk: Leak risk due to dents, damaged bungs/lids, or worn seals; photos can’t confirm tightness.
risks.proof: Ask for a short video of one drum: close-up of bung/lid and a simple water/air leak test demonstration (or proof of pressure test).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as used drums with possible leaks/unknown seal condition (worst case: treat as not guaranteed leak-proof).

risks.proof: Ask for a clear photo of the drum capacity marking/stenciling or a tape-measure shot (height and diameter).
risks.if_unproven: Priced at the lowest common value tier for used drums until capacity is confirmed.

risks.risk: Quantity/availability mismatch (photos show many, but seller may not have enough for 50 pickups this week).
risks.proof: Ask for current available count and whether they can load 50 units in one batch (photo of the yard count or loading plan).
risks.if_unproven: Priced assuming limited availability per pickup batch; confirm before committing.

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of any drum label/stenciling (capacity and prior contents/grade).
Photo of the inside of one drum (open bung) showing lining/coating condition.
Video showing bung/lid and how it seals (and any leak test if available).
A tape-measure or clear height/diameter photo to confirm capacity/size.
Confirm how many drums are available now for 50 pickups this week and whether they can be loaded together.
response.reason: The photos confirm used metal liquid drums, but key pricing drivers (capacity, condition/leak-proofness, and compatibility with liquids) are not verifiable from the images alone.
